notes:
Passed on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/duburcqa__jiminy --backend fake exited 0 with evidence contract_checked (never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. NOT COVERED: the four other entry symbols of the card (AcrobotJiminyEnv, AntJiminyEnv, CassieJiminyEnv, DigitJiminyEnv) are other environments of the same repository; this package binds only cartpole / CartPoleJiminyEnv. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('cartpole')) was not run: it needs the compiled Jiminy engine, NumPy and Gymnasium, and gym_jiminy.envs must be imported first to run its register() calls. The fake backend is this package's pure Python point-mass cart-pole (fake.py) and was never compared with an upstream run; its observation is the full four-value EncoderSensor vector, not a reduced array. The upstream code, not its docstring table, was followed: the discrete action space is Discrete(3) (left, zero, right), not Discrete(2). Warnings are the five expected of a Gymnasium family driver and are left as generated by the bridge: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, seed on reset and seed on seed). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings: the URDF facts cite the tracked data/ path (the package-local envs/data entry is a symlink at the pinned commit). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last run printed.
